end.parentNote: Ishita practised visualising square-number pictures by describing equal rows and columns and calculating totals. Ishita used the new-row-plus-new-column method and then included the shared corner to reach 11 added dots; the corner-point mix-up was resolved in the lesson. At home, Ishita can draw 1-by-1, 2-by-2, and 3-by-3 dot squares and say how many dots are added each time.
